THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.title: The Unwritten
THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.pages.INITIAL: The Architect has planned your ending. Take one possibility he did not account for.
THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.pages.DONE.de: Leave a flaw in his perfect design.
THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.talk.firstVis: He calls it perfection. I call it a cage. Take something he did not plan for.
THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.talk.ANY.0-0r: No design survives every possibility. Choose yours.
There is still room for a mistake. Make it his.
